pan_update_policy: PAN card updates are processed by NSDL/UTIITSL. Changes typically take 15-20 working days. A fee may apply.
aadhaar_update_policy: Aadhaar updates are processed by UIDAI. Online updates for name, address, and DOB are allowed. Biometric updates require a visit to an Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
pan_status_policy: PAN application status can also be tracked on the NSDL or UTIITSL website using your acknowledgement number.
aadhaar_correction_policy: Aadhaar corrections can be done online via myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in or offline at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra. Max 2 online updates allowed per field.
privacy_note: We never ask for OTP, biometrics, or full Aadhaar digits over this channel. Government services are free — beware of fraud.
